plugins.name: stackpilot
plugins.description: General methodology for coding agents through one StackPilot entry: design, spec, plan, TDD, review, verification, and finish. Includes a full Claude Code host adapter for autonomous sprints.

plugins.name: stackpilot
plugins.description: One StackPilot entry for coding-agent methodology: exploration, design, spec, plan, TDD, review, verification, and finish. Claude Code has the full sprint adapter; Codex can use the portable internal gates.

plugins.name: stackpilot
plugins.description: One StackPilot entry for coding-agent methodology: design, spec, plan, TDD, review, verification, and finish gates.

skills.name: architecture-review
skills.description: Analyzes existing codebase patterns to make decisive architecture choices and deliver implementation blueprints. Use before implementing multi-file features, when facing architectural decisions, or when a task touches shared data structures. Read-only — never writes source code.
skills.description_zh: 只读分析现有代码模式，做出架构选择并形成实施蓝图；适用于多文件功能、架构决策及共享数据结构变更，不修改源代码。

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.
headings: Anti-Pattern: "This Is Too Simple To Need A Design"
skills.description_zh: 在新增功能、组件或修改行为前探索用户意图、需求和设计，先开展头脑风暴再实施。

skills.name: qa-12-dimensions
skills.description: Systematic test coverage using a 12-dimension scenario matrix plus two-stage code review. Use when writing tests, reviewing code changes, or doing QA on completed features. Catches edge cases that happy-path-only testing misses.
skills.description_zh: 利用十二维场景矩阵和两阶段代码审核开展系统测试与 QA，覆盖正常路径以外的边界情况。

skills.name: stackpilot-bootstrap
skills.description: Use when starting any conversation. Establishes automatic routing before work - requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions.
skills.description_zh: 为新会话建立自动技能路由；原文要求在回复和澄清前先调用适用技能。

skills.name: stackpilot-completion-verification
skills.description: Internal/default StackPilot evidence-before-claims completion gate. Trigger behind the StackPilot entry before saying work is complete, fixed, passing, ready to merge, or ready for PR. Verifies commands, requirements, acceptance criteria, and finish choices with fresh evidence.
skills.description_zh: 作为 StackPilot 的完成验证门禁，在宣称完成、修复、通过或可合并前，以最新证据核对命令、需求、验收标准和结束方式。

skills.name: stackpilot-methodology
skills.description: Internal/default StackPilot gate for feature work in any agent host. Trigger behind the StackPilot entry before implementation to drive exploration, design, spec, criteria, plan, execution, verification, and finish through host-native tools or adapters.
skills.description_zh: 作为 StackPilot 的功能开发门禁，组织探索、设计、规格、标准、计划、实施、验证和收尾，并使用所在代理环境的工具或适配器。

skills.name: stackpilot-parallel-agents
skills.description: Internal/default StackPilot parallel-dispatch gate. Trigger behind the StackPilot entry when there are two or more independent tasks, failures, research targets, or review domains that can be handled concurrently without shared state or file conflicts.
skills.description_zh: 作为 StackPilot 的并行分派门禁，识别两个以上互不依赖且无共享状态或文件冲突的任务、研究或审核领域。

skills.name: stackpilot-plan-execution
skills.description: Internal/default StackPilot execution gate. Trigger behind the StackPilot entry when a spec or plan exists and work should be executed task-by-task with TDD, isolated workspaces/subagents when available, spec-compliance review before quality review, and controller verification before advancing.
skills.description_zh: 作为 StackPilot 的实施门禁，按现有规格和计划逐项执行 TDD；可用时采用隔离工作区或子代理，先审核规格符合度再审核质量，并核验后推进。

skills.name: stackpilot-planning
skills.description: Internal/default StackPilot planning gate. Trigger behind the StackPilot entry when a spec, design, or clear requirement exists and code has not started. Produces task-sized plans with exact files, dependencies, verification commands, TDD steps, and fully resolved task descriptions.
skills.description_zh: 作为 StackPilot 的计划门禁，在编码前按任务明确文件、依赖、验证命令、TDD 步骤及完整执行说明。

skills.name: stackpilot-research
skills.description: Deep research using cross-longitudinal analysis (横纵分析法). Produces 10,000-30,000 word narrative research reports on any subject: products, companies, technologies, frameworks, protocols, or people. Only invoke when the user explicitly calls /stackpilot-research. Do NOT auto-trigger on general research or analysis requests.
skills.description_zh: 通过横纵分析法开展深度研究，形成约一万至三万词的叙述报告；仅在用户明确调用 /stackpilot-research 时使用。

skills.name: stackpilot-review-response
skills.description: Internal/default StackPilot review-response gate. Trigger behind the StackPilot entry when receiving human or external review feedback before accepting, rejecting, or implementing suggestions. Requires technical verification, scoped fixes, and fresh tests.
skills.description_zh: 作为 StackPilot 的审核反馈门禁，在接受、拒绝或实施外部意见前做技术核验，限定修复范围并运行新的测试。

skills.name: stackpilot-skill-authoring
skills.description: Maintainer-only StackPilot skill-authoring gate. Trigger when adding, updating, or reviewing StackPilot skills so trigger scope, hard gates, progressive disclosure, tests, docs, and host neutrality are all verified.
skills.description_zh: 供 StackPilot 维护者新增、修改或审核技能，检查触发范围、强制门禁、渐进披露、测试、文档及跨宿主适配。

skills.name: stackpilot-sync
skills.description: Manage external skill references inlined into stackpilot agents. Use /stackpilot-sync add to extract and track a new skill, /stackpilot-sync check to detect updates in previously referenced skills.
skills.description_zh: 管理内联到 StackPilot 代理中的外部技能引用，支持提取并跟踪新技能，以及检查已有引用的更新。

skills.name: stackpilot-workspace
skills.description: Internal/default StackPilot workspace gate. Trigger behind the StackPilot entry before executing implementation plans or non-trivial feature work to detect existing isolation, prefer host-native workspaces, fall back to git worktrees, run setup, and verify a clean baseline.
skills.description_zh: 作为 StackPilot 的工作区门禁，检查现有隔离环境，优先使用宿主原生工作区，必要时采用 Git worktree，运行初始化并核对干净基线。

skills.name: stackpilot
skills.description: Primary Claude Code entry and host adapter for the StackPilot methodology. Turns feature requests into working code through a 5-node pipeline (Exploration → Design → Spec & Criteria → Plan & Run Sprint → Finish) using Claude Code-native agents, tasks, worktrees, and verification gates. Use in Claude Code when starting, resuming, tidying, or checking on development work.
headings: Step 0+1: Initialize (single bash call — do NOT split)
Sprint Interrupted (plans exist, no active TaskList from this session)
skills.description_zh: 作为 Claude Code 中的 StackPilot 入口和宿主适配器，以探索、设计、规格及标准、计划实施、收尾五阶段推进开发，衔接代理、任务、工作树与验证门禁。

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.description: Structured 4-phase debugging methodology with root cause investigation. Use when fixing bugs, diagnosing errors, troubleshooting failures, or when a fix attempt didn't work. Prevents symptom-level patching through mandatory investigation before any code changes.
headings: Red Flags — Return to Phase 1 Immediately
skills.description_zh: 采用四阶段根因调查方法诊断缺陷、错误和失败，在修改代码前完成调查，避免仅修补表面症状。

skills.name: tdd-development
skills.description: Enforces Test-Driven Development with a rigorous verify/fix loop and root cause investigation. Use when implementing features, fixing bugs, or writing any production code. Prevents symptom-level patching through mandatory 4-phase investigation before fixes.
headings: RED — Write a failing test first
GREEN — Write minimal code to pass
REFACTOR — Clean up without changing behavior
skills.description_zh: 通过严格的验证修复循环落实测试驱动开发；实现功能或修复缺陷时，要求先完成四阶段根因调查。
